name: java2python
description: The java2python Claude Code plugin: translate Java source to Python with the j2py compiler.

plugins.name: j2p
plugins.description: Translate Java source to Python with the java2python (j2py) compiler, then repair what a grammar-driven translator cannot get right on its own. The parser handles structure, control flow and operators; the model fixes what needs type knowledge, such as string concatenation, the Java standard library and integer remainder.
